name: NQ RESISTANCE ZONE ENGINE (frozen, standalone)
pivot_methodology: Zigzag pivots on FRONT-month 1-minute bars, three reversal scales in parallel: threshold = {0.15, 0.35, 0.75} x ATR (ticks). A pivot HIGH exists when price reverses down from a running maximum by >= threshold; it is CONFIRMED at the first bar where that reversal completes (i_confirm). Pivots repaint-free: a zone may only exist from its confirmation bar onward.
zone_width: half-width hw = clip(base/2, floor 4 ticks (=1.0 pt), cap 0.03*ATR14) where base = high-low range of the 10 minutes up to and including the pivot bar (BASE_MIN=10). Zone = [price_rf - hw, price_rf + hw]. Widths vary because pre-pivot base ranges and ATR vary; cap binds in high ATR, floor in tiny bases.
near_far_edges: for resistance role (approach from below): near edge = price_rf - hw (lower), far edge = price_rf + hw (upper)
creation_activation: created at pivot confirmation minute (form_min within form session); tradeable/displayable from confirmation onward; same-session bars before form_min are masked
lifecycle: retired after MAX_AGE_SESSIONS=30 sessions since formation OR MAX_TAPS=6 lifetime taps; decisive acceptance beyond the far edge (engine cat-F, close-dwell ACCEPT_DWELL with no reclaim) marks the zone flipped/broken (state knowable 2h later per display convention)
tap_definition: band contact on dense 1-second data; a NEW tap requires prior re-arm: 1s closes out of the band by max(8 ticks, half-width) hysteresis AND >= REARM_S=900 s separation from the previous tap; tap counter is per-zone lifetime, increments at each armed contact
invalidation: age>30 sessions, taps>=6, or flip acceptance (above)
overlapping_zones: no merge rule exists: zones from different scales/pivots coexist independently (nesting is informative); display layer ranks zones but geometry is never merged
contract_roll: front month selected per session from PRIOR-session symbol volumes (causal, seeded); cross-roll continuity via per-chain additive tick adjustment (roll_adjust); zone prices live in adjusted space; bars remain raw per contract
session_day: session = 22:00 UTC (prev day) -> 21:00 UTC, CME calendar; segments coded from a fixed UTC-8 minute-of-day convention (asia/london/premkt/ny-am/ny-pm)
atr_dependency: ATR14 = mean of prior 14 sessions' RTH (13:30-20:00Z summer) ranges, shifted one session (never includes current session); used ONLY for zigzag thresholds and the width cap
data_dependencies: 1m OHLC (zigzag, ATR, width base); 1s OHLC (tap detection + re-arm hysteresis); per-session symbol volumes (roll); NO volume/delta/model dependencies for the zone geometry itself
